dataDictionary.description: A person enrolled in the Morrow & Finch loyalty programme. No real personal data is used.
fields: One of the nine configured regions
True or false; independent of programme state

dataDictionary.description: One programme account per customer; the materialised balance is derived from the ledger.
fields: >= 0 in valid rows; equals ledger sum unless labelled mismatch
>= 0; pending earns are excluded from available balance
Sum of positive accrual, bonus and adjustment rows
Trailing 365-day net eligible spend after returns

dataDictionary.description: Configured membership tier and its qualifying-spend threshold.
Versioned earning, redemption, expiry, tier and bonus policy with effective dates.
fields: Null means current; later than effective_from

dataDictionary.description: A completed purchase used as the source for accrual and return events.
fields: Within dataset window; after account open
Required for store orders; null otherwise
Sum of eligible line net; excludes gift cards, tax and shipping
Required iff status is partially_returned or returned; after order_ts

dataDictionary.description: Product-level purchase line. Points accrue per eligible line, giving source-level traceability.
fields: Synthetic SKU; no real catalogue data
apparel | footwear | home | beauty | accessories | gift_card

dataDictionary.description: Immutable, signed points ledger. Positive rows create lots; negative rows consume or remove them.
fields: ACCRUAL | REVERSAL | REDEMPTION | EXPIRATION | BONUS | ADJUSTMENT
Non-zero; positive for ACCRUAL/BONUS/ADJUSTMENT, negative otherwise
Required for ACCRUAL and order-linked REVERSAL
Required for line-level ACCRUAL and REVERSAL
Required for REVERSAL; references an ACCRUAL row
For EXPIRATION, the accrual/bonus lot that expired
Tier used for earning; null for non-accrual rows
Present for ACCRUAL rows; matches rule-tier bridge
Required for positive earning rows; later than posted_at

dataDictionary.description: Catalogue item that can be redeemed for points. Tier eligibility is many-to-many.
One redemption attempt and its evaluated decision. Rejected attempts are retained and never posted.
fields: approved | insufficient_balance | concurrent_lock | reward_inactive | below_minimum | account_suspended
Account ledger balance immediately before decision
Set for concurrent attempts; at most one approval per group

dataDictionary.description: Idempotent expiry run. Each batch removes remaining points from one or more due lots for one account.
fields: Batch cut-off; >= each expired lot's expires_at
> 0; equals sum of linked EXPIRATION rows
Unique in valid rows; duplicate intentionally labelled

dataDictionary.description: Append-only account tier changes, with the qualifying spend and rule that caused the change.
fields: Null on opening tier; otherwise references tiers
Trailing 365-day net eligible spend at decision

idRules.rule: LOY- + customer_id. One account per customer.
ORD- + order year + six-digit year sequence.
OL- + order year + six-digit line sequence.
